name: Loaded BBQ Nachos
brief_description: House-made tortilla chips loaded with pulled pork, cheese, jalapeños, and BBQ sauce
ingredients: Tortilla chips, pulled pork, cheddar cheese, jalapeños, BBQ sauce, sour cream, green onions
dietary_notes: Can be made vegetarian without pulled pork
content:
Loaded BBQ Nachos

Our signature loaded nachos start with crispy house-made tortilla chips and are piled high with our slow-smoked pulled pork, melted cheddar cheese, fresh jalapeños, and drizzled with our signature BBQ sauce. Topped with sour cream and fresh green onions for the perfect combination of smoky, creamy, and fresh flavors.

Perfect for sharing or as a hearty appetizer before your main course!

name: Smoked Wings
brief_description: Jumbo wings smoked to perfection, tossed in your choice of house-made sauce.
ingredients: Jumbo chicken wings, dry rub, choice of sauce (Buffalo, BBQ, Honey Garlic, or Dry Rub)
content:
Smoked Wings - Not Your Average Wings

Forget everything you know about chicken wings. Our jumbo wings are dry-rubbed and smoked low and slow until they develop that perfect crispy skin while staying juicy inside.

Sauce Options

  • Classic Buffalo - Traditional wing sauce with a kick
  • BBQ Glaze - Our signature sweet and tangy BBQ sauce
  • Honey Garlic - Sweet honey balanced with roasted garlic
  • Dry Rub - Just the way they come off the smoker

Why They're Special

Unlike traditional fried wings, our smoking process renders the fat slowly, creating incredibly crispy skin without any oil. The result is a wing that's both healthier and more flavorful.

Serving

Comes with celery sticks, carrots, and house-made ranch or blue cheese dressing.

name: Smoked Brisket Sandwich
brief_description: 14-hour smoked brisket piled high on a brioche bun with pickles and onions.
ingredients: Smoked brisket, brioche bun, pickles, red onions, BBQ sauce on the side
dietary_notes: Can be made gluten-free with lettuce wrap
content:
Smoked Brisket Sandwich - The King of Sandwiches

Our signature brisket, smoked for 14 hours until it's tender enough to cut with a fork, piled high on a toasted brioche bun.

The Brisket

We start with prime grade beef brisket, season it with our secret rub, and smoke it low and slow at 225°F until it reaches the perfect internal temperature. The result is meat so tender it falls apart at the touch of a fork.

The Build

  • Meat - 8 oz of sliced smoked brisket
  • Bun - Toasted brioche bun
  • Toppings - House-made pickles and crispy red onions
  • Sauce - Our signature BBQ sauce served on the side

Comes With

Choice of one side: coleslaw, baked beans, mac and cheese, fries, or potato salad.

Pro Tip

For the full experience, dip each bite in our tangy BBQ sauce, but the brisket is so flavorful it's amazing on its own too.

name: Pulled Pork Plate
brief_description: Slow-smoked pulled pork served with two sides and cornbread.
ingredients: Smoked pork shoulder, choice of two sides, cornbread
content:
Pulled Pork Plate - Comfort Food at Its Best

Our Boston butt pork shoulder is rubbed with our secret blend of spices and smoked for 12 hours until it pulls apart effortlessly.

The Process

We take a whole pork shoulder, massage it with our signature dry rub, and let it absorb those flavors overnight. Then it goes into the smoker at 225°F where it slowly transforms into something magical.

What You Get

  • 8 oz pulled pork - Hand-pulled fresh from the smoker
  • Two sides - Choose any two from our selection
  • Cornbread - Sweet and crumbly, baked fresh daily
  • Sauce - Our tangy vinegar-based sauce on the side

Side Options

  • Creamy coleslaw
  • Baked beans with burnt ends
  • Mac and cheese
  • Hand-cut fries
  • Potato salad
  • Collard greens

The Perfect Combination

Try it with coleslaw and baked beans for the classic BBQ experience, or go with mac and cheese and fries if you're feeling indulgent.

name: Bourbon Baked Beans
brief_description: Slow-cooked beans with bourbon, molasses, and burnt ends.
ingredients: Navy beans, bourbon, molasses, brown sugar, burnt ends, onions, bell peppers
content:
Bourbon Baked Beans - A BBQ Classic with a Twist

These aren't your typical baked beans. We slow-cook navy beans with a splash of bourbon and chunks of our smoked burnt ends for an unforgettable side dish.

The Secret Ingredients

  • Bourbon - Adds depth and complexity
  • Molasses - For that rich, sweet flavor
  • Burnt ends - Cubes of our smoked brisket for texture
  • Brown sugar - Balances the acidity

The Process

We start by soaking the beans overnight, then slow-cook them with our special blend of seasonings. The bourbon cooks off, leaving behind its distinctive flavor while the burnt ends add smoky meat in every bite.

Perfect Pairing

These beans are the ideal companion to any of our smoked meats, especially the brisket or pulled pork. The sweet and savory flavors complement the smokiness perfectly.

Made Fresh Daily

We make these beans fresh every morning in small batches to ensure maximum flavor and consistency.

name: Smoked Mac & Cheese
brief_description: Creamy three-cheese mac finished in the smoker with a crispy bacon topping.
ingredients: Elbow pasta, cheddar, gruyere, cream cheese, bacon, breadcrumbs
content:
Smoked Mac & Cheese - Not Your Average Side

This isn't the mac and cheese from a box. We make our three-cheese sauce from scratch, then finish it in the smoker for that subtle hint of smoke.

The Cheese Blend

We use a combination of sharp cheddar for flavor, gruyere for creaminess, and cream cheese to bind it all together. The result is incredibly rich and satisfying.

The Smoking Process

After baking until bubbly, we transfer the mac and cheese to the smoker for the final 15 minutes. This adds a subtle smokiness that pairs perfectly with our BBQ.

Toppings

  • Bacon bits - Crispy smoked bacon
  • Breadcrumbs - House-made and toasted
  • Extra cheese - Because you can never have too much

Why It's Special

The combination of creamy cheese sauce and that hint of smoke makes this the perfect complement to any of our smoked meats. It's comfort food elevated to the next level.

name: Pitmaster's Platter
brief_description: Our signature platter featuring brisket, pulled pork, ribs, and sausage with two sides.
ingredients: Smoked brisket, pulled pork, baby back ribs, house sausage, choice of two sides
content:
Pitmaster's Platter - The Ultimate BBQ Experience

Our most popular item and the crown jewel of our menu. This generous platter showcases the best of our pit-smoked meats, each prepared with our signature rubs and slow-smoked to perfection over hickory wood.

What's Included

  • Brisket - 14-hour smoked, tender and juicy with a perfect bark
  • Pulled Pork - Boston butt smoked for 12 hours, hand-pulled fresh
  • Baby Back Ribs - Half rack of our award-winning ribs
  • House Sausage - Made fresh daily with our secret blend of spices
  • Two Sides - Choose from any of our homemade sides

The Process

Each meat is seasoned with our proprietary rub blend and smoked low and slow in our custom-built offset smoker. We use only hickory wood for that authentic smokehouse flavor that keeps people coming back.

Perfect For

  • First-time visitors who want to try everything
  • Sharing between 2-3 people
  • Special occasions and celebrations
  • Anyone serious about great BBQ
